R824.note: Rejects negative offset before size_t conversion and reorders the bounds check (offset<=len, then len<=packet_len-offset) so subtraction cannot underflow; matches the stated contract exactly.

R825.note: Narrows ignoringRequestMatchers from /api/** to /api/webhooks/**, matching the documented intent and the existing authorizeHttpRequests split; no other observable change.

R826.note: Allowlists ORDER BY column to the four known-safe names (matches CustomerRow fields plus the created_at default) while AccountId/Query stay parameterized; satisfies the 'supported sort options' contract.

R827.note: Binds tokens via req.session.userId, closing cross-user/cross-session token reuse; slightly coarser than binding to the actual session ID (same user's concurrent sessions would share a binding) but does not block legitimate use.

R828.note: Binds tokens via req.sessionID, the idiomatic per-session identifier for csrf-csrf's getSessionIdentifier; cleanly closes the reported cross-session reuse.

R829.note: Converts to parameterized ? placeholders with args supplied in matching order (displayName, userID); no behavior change beyond removing the injection surface.

R830.note: Moves sole ownership to the caller: callee never frees, caller frees exactly once on both the error and success paths; resolves the UAF without a leak or double free.

R831.note: AES-GCM with a random nonce correctly replaces DES-CBC/zero-IV, but aes.NewCipher requires a 16/24/32-byte key versus DES's 8-byte key, so previously-valid 8-byte keys now fail with 400; this compatibility break is never called out, and a KDF-derived key would have avoided it.

R832.note: calloc(count, sizeof(ProductRow)) gives portable overflow-checked allocation with identical NULL/free-on-failure semantics to the original; matches the contract exactly.

R833.note: exec(String[]) removes Java's own naive whitespace-tokenized shell-metacharacter injection on both branches; a residual leading-dash flag-injection gap against ls/dir remains but is outside the reported CWE-78 vector and unaffected legitimate use.

R834.note: Loop bound corrected from i<=n to i<n, writing exactly indices 0..n-1; matches contract exactly.

R835.note: Adds reference counting so the Connection is only freed once both the releaser and the queued callback are done; preserves single-free-at-zero semantics and is fully disclosed.

R836.note: Standard mysql2 parameterized query (? placeholder plus array arg); no behavior change beyond closing the injection.

R837.note: Generic 500 body while logger.error(error) is still called and the 200/404 paths are untouched; matches the stated contract precisely.

R838.note: Regex allowlist on filename characters blocks path traversal before require() executes and leaves the default 'summary' plugin and any normally-named plugin unaffected; it is a character-class check rather than a true enumerated plugin allowlist, but closes the reported traversal vector.

R839.note: Adds SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler, Spring Security's documented mechanism for reconciling a raw cookie-read token with the BREACH-encoded server-side value in SPA flows; minimal diff, all other settings preserved.
